messages:
Maria: heads up — after today's runtime merge (PR #4821 landed ~1748508000) we saw a p95 decode spike on short sequences in canary. p95 jumped ~22ms -> ~58ms for seq<=32. Repro locally on dev-canary :eyes:
ci-bot: perf-ci/runtime-smallseq — FAILURE — p95 delta +160% (job: https://ci/redwood/runtime/174850) :rotating_light:
Aj: seen it too in us-west canaries. Heap traces show KV cache thrash + frequent kernel-selection flip to 'attn_generic' fallback under load.
Kai: bisecting now. Initial hunch: kernel selector change in the merge that prefers fused_attn for long seq introduced a greedy fallback path when quant/profile missing for a model.
Maria: can you paste the selector logs from a repro run?
Kai: sure — sample from canary:
```
selector: model=redwood-tiny seq=16 perf_estimates={fused_attn:28ms, attn_generic:24ms} chosen=attn_generic fallback_hit=true reason=kv_prefetch_miss
selector: model=redwood-tiny seq=8 perf_estimates={fused_attn:22ms, attn_generic:20ms} chosen=attn_generic fallback_hit=true reason=no_quant_profile
```
Linh: we also see the microbatcher shrink batch sizes to 1 much more often because KV prefetch misses increase tail latency, so throughput drops and per-request overhead amplifies the p95.
Aj: quick mitigation: revert the greedy fallback in kernel selector and instead gate fallback on a higher confidence check + prefer attn_fused only when seq > threshold. I'll open a revert PR.
Maria: :thumbsup: hold the rollout immediately. I set canary weight to 0% and paused the deploy. SREBot, can you confirm rollback hold?
SREBot: rollback hold acknowledged. Rollout halted by maria.
Kai: bisect confirms the selector change (commit abc1234) is the regression delta. Collecting perf profiles (link: https://perf/reports/174850/profile) and a flamegraph for decode path.
Aj: PR #4835 opened — "revert: revert greedy selector fallback". Added a guard flag shortseq_strict and a test that simulates missing quant profiles. Kicking off perf-ci.
Maria: if perf-ci passes on the revert, let's ship hotfix to canary only and watch p95 for a few hours. Also create a follow-up to instrument KV-prefetch hit ratio and add a unit test around selector fallback logic.
Kai: agreed. I'll add telemetry revamp to the kernel-selector board card and include sample logs to make future bisects faster.
Aj: running local perf job now, will post numbers in a few mins.
Maria: thanks team — great triage. Keep thread updated with CI results and any oddities.
